recommended_action: Do not pay; contact the admissions office through its official website or phone number and ask whether any fee applies.
summary_for_user: The poster says there is no application fee, but the QR code does not open an application form at all: it is a UPI payment request for INR 499 to a personal-looking account named 'Rahul Kumar', with the note 'Application Fee'. The physical claim and the digital action contradict each other directly. This is highly suspicious; verify with the institution before paying anything.
